channel.title: Four of Hearts Interactive News
channel.description: Company and game news from Four of Hearts Interactive.

item.title: Introducing Thumb Command: Save Planet Earth
item.description: Meet the Blueguard interceptor, the cities it protects, and the worldwide fight at the heart of Four of Hearts Interactive’s new arcade-defense direction.

item.title: The City Is the Base: Building Thumb Command’s New Battlefields
item.description: Why Chicago sits directly beneath the player—and how five cities turn shield defense into a worldwide arcade campaign.

item.title: Meet the Blueguard: Earth’s Last Interceptor
item.description: Inside Thumb Command’s blue-white-gold hero ship, responsive arcade control, and Vanguard, Sentinel, and Paladin upgrade path.

item.title: Designing the Alien Invasion of Thumb Command
item.description: How purple silhouettes, readable formations, distinct enemy classes, and a massive Mothership create family-friendly arcade pressure.

item.title: From Chicago to Tokyo: The Thumb Command World Tour
item.description: Five cities establish a worldwide campaign—and a flexible foundation for future Thumb Command missions.

item.title: Bobby the Breadasaurus Joins the Four of Hearts Family
item.description: A brave little dinosaur and a bread-filled world begin their journey at Four of Hearts Interactive.

item.title: Evil Doom Adventures: Shadow Run Enters Development
item.description: Two shadow heroes begin a dangerous rescue story built around movement, trust, and finding a way through together.

item.title: Why We're Building Palace
item.description: A familiar card-table game deserves a modern home that respects its mystery, momentum, and many table traditions.

item.title: Palace Enters Founder Testing
item.description: The flagship Four of Hearts experience is in hands-on internal testing, with attention on clarity, feel, and the full table journey.

item.title: Meet the Seven Games in the 4OH Family
item.description: Seven distinct worlds now share one independent studio: Palace, Bobby, Evil Doom Adventures, Thumb Command, Hearts, Spades, and Euchre.

item.title: Building a Safer, Family-Friendly Card Table
item.description: How Four of Hearts approaches clear policies, restrained data use, accessibility, and honest Internal Alpha communication.

item.title: Welcome to Four of Hearts Interactive
item.description: Meet the South Dakota studio building seven distinct game worlds across card, arcade, platform, puzzle, and adventure genres.
